about.headline: Hi, I'm Noé. I link text to places on Earth.
bio: I am an AI Research Engineer at Inria. I focus on LLM-based geoparsing to link unstructured text to geographic footprints.
I am building side projects, which you can find on my [GitHub](https://github.com/NoeFlandre), and conducting research.
I am looking for opportunities to gain expertise in AI while contributing to its development in an open, thoughtful and responsible way.

recommendations.name: Philippe Giabbanelli
recommendations.role: (Full) Research Professor, VMASC, Old Dominion University
recommendations.relation: Direct supervisor during two summer internships
recommendations.quote: I was Noe's sole supervisor during his two summer internships in 2024. He did a truly impressive amount of work and he was able to quickly learn the ropes of being a researcher in an international center. I am confident that several publications at reputable venues will eventually arise from his commendable efforts.

recommendations.name: Johann Desloires
recommendations.role: Geospatial Data Scientist | EO & ML | End-to-End Applications
recommendations.relation: Worked with Noé on the same team
recommendations.quote: I had the pleasure of meeting Noé during his internship at Airbus Defence and Space and hearing about his work on vision-language models for remote sensing. While I was not his direct supervisor, I was impressed by the quality of his final presentation, his technical understanding, and his ability to clearly communicate his work. I wish Noé all the best for the next steps of his career and would be happy to recommend him.

recommendations.name: Gerard Dray
recommendations.quote: I highly recommend Noe Flandre for any professional opportunity in his field of expertise. Having worked with him during a research initiation project, I observed his rigor, professionalism, and ability to successfully manage complex projects.
